title: claude-kit project config (v2)
description: Identity layer of a kit project. Resolved in cascade workspace -> project -> island by scripts/lib/kit-config-resolve.sh; the nearest layer wins. The $schema reference in kit.config.json points here so editors validate + autocomplete.

kitVersion.description: Kit version that last wrote/wired this config. Drives self-heal: when it differs from the installed plugin, kit-wire re-converges.

mode.description: How strict the kit is HERE. draft = guardrails off (explore freely); guided = warnings, never block; enforced = guardrails block (worktree-only, PR-per-issue). Set per cascade level — an island can be enforced while its parent workspace is guided.

workspace.description: Present only in kit.workspace.json (the workspace-root marker). Holds settings shared across every project under the workspace.

commons.description: Path (relative to the workspace root) of the promoted skills/agents commons. Default .claude/.

language.description: Comms language, e.g. en, es, mixed.

profile.description: Active role profile (minimal, software, content, research, automation, ...).

skillPrefix.description: Namespace prepended to kit-namespaced workflow skills on scaffold/upgrade (e.g. "kit-" -> kit-task-close). Empty = bare names. See templates/skills/NAMESPACED.

modules.description: Stackable modules added on top of the profile (e.g. "software"). Empty/absent = base project.

baseBranch.description: Integration branch the lifecycle skills branch from and merge into (default: main; e.g. develop).

integrationBranch.description: Alias for baseBranch, honored when baseBranch is unset (adoption fallback).

flow.description: Last-resort alias for the integration branch, honored when baseBranch and integrationBranch are unset.

projectOwnerType.description: Whether the Projects v2 board is owned by a user or an organization login (default: user). Selects the GraphQL root for board queries.

flows.description: Controlled flow vocabulary for effort titles — the values accepted by the leading [Flow] title tag and `--flow` (also the flow:<flow> labels). Replaces the built-in default (Core UI API Docs Infra Auth Data Web App); an explicit EFFORT_FLOWS env var still wins per invocation.

knowledgeIngestHook.description: Optional path to an executable run after `cckit effort close`, invoked as `<hook> <effort-number> <trace-dir>` to fold the closed effort's work record into a knowledge base. No-op when unset or not executable; the kit ships no default.

wipLimit.description: How many efforts may be in progress at once before `cckit effort start` refuses a NEW effort (default 2). In progress = an `effort/<N>-<slug>` branch exists as a local head or on origin (read with `git ls-remote`, not the cached refs/remotes; EFFORT_WIP_REMOTE=0 or an unreachable origin counts the cached refs instead). Refusal happens before anything is written; `--force` (or KIT_FORCE=1) starts anyway. 0 refuses every ordinary start of a NEW effort but not a forced one, and not a re-start of an effort already in progress (that adds no WIP, so it is never gated); a non-integer value is ignored with a warning and the default is used. An explicit EFFORT_WIP_LIMIT env var wins per invocation. Does not affect `cckit start <issue>`.

agents.description: Named agent profiles and the stage vocabulary they are allowed at. A profile is project configuration, not workflow logic: cckit reads the vendor model id, reasoning level and CLI arguments from here so no stage in the kit hard-codes them. Resolution precedence is command override > issue metadata > parent effort metadata > `agents.default` (see `cckit effort`/orchestration docs).

default.description: Profile name used when nothing more specific resolves. Must name a key of `agents.profiles`; a `default` that names no declared profile is a validation error, not a silent fallback.

stages.description: Controlled stage vocabulary a profile's `stages` entries are checked against. Replaces the built-in default (build review design docs); an explicit CCKIT_AGENT_STAGES env var wins per invocation.

kind.description: The agent CLI/provider this profile runs, e.g. `claude` or `codex`. Must be a kind the selected runtime can start — the Herdr runtime validates it before any worktree is created.

model.description: Vendor model identifier passed to the CLI. Lives here precisely so stage logic never names a model; the kit only forwards whatever this says. Omit to use the CLI's own configured default.

reasoning.description: Reasoning/effort level, for CLIs that accept one. Forwarded verbatim; the kit does not validate vendor-specific values because they change per provider.

args.description: Extra CLI arguments appended to the launch command, as an argv array (never a shell string, so nothing is re-parsed by a shell).

permissions.description: Permission/sandbox policy this profile runs under, forwarded to the CLI that implements it. Recorded in the stage receipt so a run's effective policy is auditable after the fact.

stages.description: Stages this profile may run at, each a value from `agents.stages`. A profile selected for a stage it does not list is refused before a worktree or pane exists.

write.description: Whether this profile may write to a branch (default false). One writer owns a branch at a time; review profiles stay read-only until ownership is explicitly transferred.

contextBudget.description: Upper bound, in bytes, on the generated brief handed to this profile's worker. The brief is truncated to fit; the board and prior conversations are never included.

profiles.description: Map of profile name to its declaration. Profile names are stable cckit policy referenced by issue and effort metadata; the vendor model id and CLI arguments inside each are project-owned.

floors.description: Auto-merge policy floors (default true). When on, `cckit watch --merge` never auto-merges a PR touching .github/workflows/**, lockfile/graph files, or security-sensitive paths, and always honors a `hold` label + draft state. Set false to disable (or KIT_CAPTAIN_FLOORS=0).

protectedGlobs.description: Extra path globs the captain must not auto-merge (added to the built-in floors). Also settable via KIT_CAPTAIN_EXTRA_GLOBS.

routines.description: Opt-in scheduled routines accepted by the user (briefing, board sweep, gc, ...). The kit SUGGESTS; the user accepts; nothing is created without opt-in.

upgrade.description: Tells `init.sh --upgrade` which scaffolded paths the project deleted/renamed ON PURPOSE so they are never re-added (#334). Paths are repo-relative (e.g. ".claude/skills/task-new"); a directory entry covers everything beneath it.

removed.description: Scaffolded paths the project deleted on purpose — the upgrade will not re-create them.

renamed.description: Map of original scaffolded path -> the project's new name. The original (key) is treated as removed (never re-added); the value documents where it went.

worktree.description: How `cckit start` / `cckit effort start` bootstrap a fresh worktree (env copy, dev port, dependency install). Every key is optional; the kit hardcodes no project layout.

installPaths.description: Worktree-relative directories to run `pnpm install` in during bootstrap (e.g. ["docs-site"]). Set, it wins outright — only these dirs are installed and the checks below are skipped; [] installs nothing. Entries MUST stay inside the worktree: an absolute path, a `..` that climbs out, or a symlink pointing outside is refused and skipped. Unset: install at the root only when its package.json declares dependencies or it is a workspace root WITH AT LEAST ONE MEMBER — a dependency-free root (or an empty `packages:` / `workspaces` list) is skipped so pnpm cannot plant an empty pnpm-lock.yaml (#255). KIT_WT_INSTALL=0 skips the install entirely.

devPorts.description: Per-app dev PORT lanes. Each entry assigns PORT = base + (issue % 40) * <count> into that app's .env.local, so parallel worktrees never fight for a port.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the app's .env.local file.

base.description: Base port for this app's lane.
